transform.name: POLARITY_AWARE_LITERAL_OCCURRENCE_SPLITTING
definition: For every literal occurrence e of variable x in a main clause, introduce a private occurrence variable y_e and replace that literal occurrence by y_e with the same polarity.
If the original occurrence is positive x, add link clause (not y_e OR x), i.e. y_e -> x.
If the original occurrence is negative not-x, add link clause (not x OR y_e), i.e. x -> y_e.
transform.semantic_status: After existentially quantifying all occurrence variables y_e, the transformed CNF is exactly equivalent to the original CNF as a Boolean function of the master variables.

semantic_proof: Fix any assignment alpha to master variables.
If an original positive literal x is false, link y_e->x forces y_e=0, so the replacement literal is false; if x is true, y_e may be chosen true when needed.
If an original negative literal not-x is false, then x=1 and link x->y_e forces y_e=1, so replacement not-y_e is false; if not-x is true, y_e may be chosen false when needed.

Therefore an original clause is satisfiable under alpha exactly when its occurrence-split main clause has an extension to its occurrence variables satisfying all corresponding links. Independent occurrence variables let these choices be made clause-by-clause.

maxdef_theorem.statement: delta*(T_split(F)) = delta*(F) for every normalized CNF F.
proof: For an arbitrary selected sub-clause-set Q of T_split(F), let A be the selected transformed main clauses and L the selected occurrence-link clauses.

Let U be all occurrence indices belonging to selected main clauses A. Selected occurrence variables are exactly U union L. Selected master variables are exactly Var(L), the original variables having at least one selected link.
Thus deficiency(Q)=|A|+|L|-|U union L|-|Var(L)| = |A|-|U minus L|-|Var(L)|.

For every original variable appearing in A, either at least one of its A-occurrences has a selected link, putting that variable in Var(L), or none does, in which case at least one distinct occurrence is counted in U minus L. Therefore |Var(L)|+|U minus L| >= |Var(A)|.

For the reverse inequality choose an original sub-clause-set A0 attaining delta*(F), select its transformed main clauses and all links for all occurrences in A0. Then U is contained in L, Var(L)=Var(A0), and deficiency equals |A0|-|Var(A0)|=delta*(F).

R44BD_effect.meaning: Literal-occurrence splitting can reduce clause overlap and variable occurrence degree while preserving exact semantics, but it cannot lower maximum deficiency.
R44BD_effect.selector_application: Applying occurrence splitting to a selector-guarded OR merge leaves the R44BE additive maximum-deficiency debt unchanged.
R44BD_effect.anti_loophole: Shared master variables plus private occurrence copies are therefore not a route to free maxdef descent.
